en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a lively street scene with people walking and socializing along a broad avenue flanked by tall buildings with distinctive enclosed balconies. The architecture is classic and ornate, with several awnings and shopfronts visible. The street is bustling with figures dressed in early 20th-century clothing. At the bottom of the postcard, there is printed and handwritten text.
